up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1932895 (Natural resistance-associated macrophage protein 2) where the standard_type is 'IC50', the standard_relation is '=', and the pChEMBL value is not null. For each row, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1932895' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
